youtube-transcript.description: Extract clean YouTube captions and transcripts for AI agents, RAG, research, summarization and automation. Accepts YouTube URLs or video IDs and can return timestamped segments.

url.description: YouTube watch, youtu.be, Shorts, Live or embed URL. Provide either url or videoId.

videoId.description: 11-character YouTube video ID. Provide either videoId or url.

language.description: Optional preferred caption language code such as en, pt, es or fr.

includeSegments.description: When true, include timestamped caption segments in addition to the full transcript.

language.description: Language code of the selected caption track.

autoGenerated.description: Whether the selected captions were automatically generated.

wordCount.description: Number of words in the transcript.

characterCount.description: Number of characters in the transcript.

segments.description: Timestamped caption segments when includeSegments is true.
